name: AdvancedEncryption.WE.Leaf.leafKey_abort_le
title: Leaf key: abort probability at most 2^-kappa
statement: Over Z_q[X]/(X^N+1), for a trapdoor matrix M with rows of norm <= rho, k N rho <= tau, binary decompositions, the big box of Bb bits and the small box famBall s with 2^(Bb-1) - 1 - tau <= s: one try of the leaf-key sampler aborts with probability <= 2^-kappa when 4 tau + 1 <= 2^Bb and m N (4 tau + 1) 2^kappa <= 2^Bb.
